page.overview:
Who is Six Jia?

The are a group of gods which represent the force of yang.

When all weapons failed to kill Sun Wukong, the Six Ding and Six Jia forced him into the Eight Trigrams Furnace.

The Six Jia were later assigned as one of the five groups of gods tasked with protecting Tang Sanzang during his journey. The gods served their shifts on rotation.

Later the Six Ding and Six Jia are said to have overseen the forging of Zhu Bajie's 9-Toothed Rake.
